message: Urgent: tell the Hovertravel captain I left my flask of Bovril in seat 4B. Do not let the Isle of Wight keep it.
Magpie — if this reaches PO1 before the 19:00 tide, tell Wren to stop saying NORTH. ECHO has learned NORTH. Use SEAWARD.
Tried to send a postcard from [REDACTED BY PORTSMOUTH MARITIME AUTHORITY] but the ink curdled as soon as we crossed the river.
driftLog: WARNING: Brief contact with SO14 Docks (Contamination Logged)

message: Day 4 on No Man's Land Fort. The seagulls have unionised and are demanding every third chip from Gunwharf.
INTERCEPT LOG 74-B: [STATIC] DROP [STATIC] PIER. Whoever keeps broadcasting the Fratton chimes on 74.2 MHz, cease immediately.
To whoever finds this bottle: I am currently stuck on the Gosport ferry going back and forth because I dropped my return ticket in the bilge.
The paper is damp and smells vaguely of [REDACTED BY PORTSMOUTH MARITIME AUTHORITY] diesel. Do not lick the cork.
Note to self: a 'short cut' across Langstone Harbour at low tide is not a short cut. Please send dry socks.
Have you noticed the tide clock at Station PO1 runs backwards whenever someone mentions Hack Pompey? Unusual, even for 1974.
If you are reading this, our submarine sandwich experiment in the Solent has achieved neutral buoyancy. Send mustard.
WREN FIELD REPORT: Package dry. Guard distracted by brass band on the promenade. Do not repeat PIER on the radio.
We drifted past [REDACTED BY PORTSMOUTH MARITIME AUTHORITY] during the fog. Our compass refused to point west out of sheer dignity.
driftLog: WARNING: Drifted through SO14 Water Column

message: Found a perfectly good typewriter on the shingle at Southsea. Only missing the letter E, which is oddly convenient for dodging ECHO.
Please inform my landlord in Albert Road that I have officially declared myself a maritime republic 400 yards off South Parade Pier.
Eaten by an ambitious Southsea seagull near Clarence Pier. Bottle and dignity unrecoverable.
driftLog: LOST AT SEA: Intercepted mid-air by avian contraband unit
obituary: Eaten by an ambitious Southsea seagull near Clarence Pier.

message: Stuck in traffic on the M27 near Junction 9. Presumed dead.
driftLog: LOST AT SEA: Never reached open water; permanently delayed on the M27
obituary: Stuck in traffic on the M27. Presumed dead.

message: Washed up in [REDACTED BY PORTSMOUTH MARITIME AUTHORITY]. Nobody there could read it.
driftLog: LOST AT SEA: Declared a total cultural write-off
obituary: Washed up in [REDACTED BY PORTSMOUTH MARITIME AUTHORITY]. Nobody there could read it.

message: Pulverised by the 14:15 Isle of Wight hovercraft at 45 knots.
driftLog: LOST AT SEA: Vaporised by hovercraft skirt
